title: Findings about the Vital Study
abstract: Thanks to your commitment to taking the study capsules and filling out the health questionnaires, we now have the results of the largest and longest randomized trial of daily high-dose vitamin D (vitamin D3 [cholecalciferol], 2000 IU) and omega-3 fatty acid supplementation (Omacor® fish oil, 1 gram) for the prevention of cancer and cardiovascular disease in generally healthy men and women without these conditions at baseline. In participants with low fish consumption (defined as less than 1½ servings per week; one serving is 3-4 ounces), omega-3 fatty acid supplementation led to a 19% reduction in major cardiovascular events, including a 40% reduction in heart attack, as well as a trend toward a reduction in death from any cause, and no indication of increased cancer risk.
